Homework week 3

Amjad and Ahmed · one day at a time · about 45 minutes

🎙️ لا تنسَ: أرسل رسالة صوتية على واتساب لبطاقة من اختيارك قبل حصة الاثنين. البطاقات في اليوم ٤

Don't forget: send a WhatsApp voice note for one speaking card before Monday's class.

Day 1 · Listening · الاستماع

اضغط ▶ واستمع بدون قراءة. ثم أجب عن الأسئلة واضغط «تحقق». استمع مرة ثالثة مع النص.

Press ▶ and listen without reading. Answer the questions, then press Check. Listen a third time with the text.

Recording 1 · A delivery problem · مشكلة في التوصيل

Karim, a truck driver, arrives at the warehouse. Ahmed meets him.

Questions · الأسئلة

  1. What time is the delivery?

  2. Which door does Karim park at?

  3. How many boxes does Karim have?

  4. Where are the other ten boxes?

  5. When does the second truck come?

  6. What is the new time for the second truck?

  7. Who is the forklift driver?

  1. KarimGood morning. I'm Karim from Cool Air. I have a delivery for you.Your turn · دورك
  2. AhmedGood morning, Karim. You're early. The delivery is at ten.Your turn · دورك
  3. KarimI know. There's no traffic today.Your turn · دورك
  4. AhmedOK, no problem. Please park at door number three.Your turn · دورك
  5. KarimHow many workers can help me?Your turn · دورك
  6. AhmedTwo workers are free now. How many boxes do you have?Your turn · دورك
  7. KarimI have eighty boxes. Forty split units and forty outdoor units.Your turn · دورك
  8. AhmedEighty? The paper says ninety.Your turn · دورك
  9. KarimTen boxes are on the second truck. It comes at two o'clock.Your turn · دورك
  10. AhmedTwo o'clock is a problem. We close the loading area at one thirty today.Your turn · دورك
  11. KarimOh, I'm sorry. Can the second truck come tomorrow morning?Your turn · دورك
  12. AhmedYes, tomorrow is fine. Please tell the driver to come at eight.Your turn · دورك
  13. KarimOK, I'll call him now. Where do I put the boxes?Your turn · دورك
  14. AhmedPut them on the pallets near door three, please. Be careful, some boxes are heavy.Your turn · دورك
  15. KarimNo problem. Is there a forklift?Your turn · دورك
  16. AhmedYes. Sami is the forklift driver. He's coming now.Your turn · دورك
  17. KarimGreat. Here is the paper.Your turn · دورك
  18. AhmedOK. Please sign here. Thank you, Karim.Your turn · دورك

Recording 2 · A phone order · طلب على الهاتف

Faisal, a customer, calls the warehouse. Ahmed answers.

Questions · الأسئلة

  1. What does Faisal want?

  2. How many split units?

  3. Which day?

  4. What time can the truck come?

  5. How does Ahmed send the price?

  6. Does the driver call Faisal before he comes?

  7. When does Faisal need the air conditioners?

  1. AhmedGood afternoon, this is Ahmed. How can I help you?Your turn · دورك
  2. FaisalHello. My name is Faisal. I want to order some air conditioners.Your turn · دورك
  3. AhmedSure. How many do you need?Your turn · دورك
  4. FaisalFifteen split units, please.Your turn · دورك
  5. AhmedFifteen or fifty?Your turn · دورك
  6. FaisalFifteen. One, five.Your turn · دورك
  7. AhmedOK. When do you need them?Your turn · دورك
  8. FaisalOn Thursday morning, if possible.Your turn · دورك
  9. AhmedThursday is fine. The truck can come at nine thirty.Your turn · دورك
  10. FaisalNine thirty is good. Can the driver call me before he comes?Your turn · دورك
  11. AhmedSure. What's your phone number?Your turn · دورك
  12. FaisalIt's oh five oh, four three two, one eight seven six.Your turn · دورك
  13. AhmedOh five oh, four three two, one eight seven six. Is that right?Your turn · دورك
  14. FaisalYes, that's right.Your turn · دورك
  15. FaisalGreat. And the price?Your turn · دورك
  16. AhmedI'll send the price by email. What's your email, please?Your turn · دورك
  17. FaisalIt's faisal, F, A, I, S, A, L, at gmail dot com.Your turn · دورك
  18. AhmedThank you, Mr. Faisal. Have a nice day.Your turn · دورك
  19. FaisalYou too. Goodbye.Your turn · دورك

Day 2 · Listen and repeat · استمع وكرّر

اضغط ▶ على الجملة واستمع، ثم كرّرها بصوت عالٍ بالسرعة نفسها. كرّر كل جملة ٣ مرات.

Press ▶, listen, then say the sentence out loud at the same speed. Repeat each sentence 3 times.

  1. 1I usually start work at seven thirty.
  2. 2The first truck comes at eight o'clock.
  3. 3We have three trucks today, and the last one comes at four.
  4. 4Could you check the boxes, please?
  5. 5How many split units do we have in stock?
  6. 6The paper says fifty, but I can only count forty-five.
  7. 7Please park at door number two and wait for me.
  8. 8My brother is the region manager, and I'm a senior supervisor.
  9. 9Our team has twelve workers and two forklift drivers.
  10. 10I'm busy at nine. How about half past ten?
  11. 11The delivery is on Thursday morning.
  12. 12Can you spell your name, please?
  13. 13I'll send you the price by email this afternoon.
  14. 14Everyone needs to wear a helmet and gloves.
  15. 15There's a problem in aisle five. Nobody is hurt.
  16. 16Please don't touch the boxes. I'm coming now.
  17. 17We don't work on Friday. I usually rest at home.
  18. 18I think a good supervisor listens to his team.
  19. 19Thank you for calling. Have a nice day.
  20. 20See you on Tuesday at eleven thirty.

Day 3 · Role play · تمثيل الأدوار

١. اضغط «استمع أولاً». الجملة التي تُقال الآن تضيء باللون الأصفر.
٢. اختر دورك. عندما تسمع الصفارة وتضيء جملتك بالأصفر، قلها بصوت عالٍ.
٣. مثّل الدورين.

1. Listen first: the line being spoken lights up in yellow. 2. Choose your role: at the beep your line lights up, so say it out loud. 3. Do both roles.

Day 4 · Speaking card · بطاقة المحادثة

اختر رقماً وافتح البطاقة. كل أخ يختار بطاقة مختلفة. فكّر دقيقة، ثم سجّل رسالة صوتية من دقيقة إلى دقيقتين على واتساب وأرسلها إلى المعلم. ابدأ برقم البطاقة.

Choose a number and open the card. Prepare for one minute, then send a 1–2 minute WhatsApp voice note. Start with the card number: “Card 9: My workday.”

1

1 · Introduce yourself

Talk · 1 minute · عرّف بنفسك

  • What's your name?
  • What's your job?
  • Where do you work?
  • Who do you work with?
UsefulHi, I'm …I'm a / an …I work at … / in …I work with …

Tap the card to fold it · اضغط على البطاقة لتطويها

2

2 · My job

Talk · 1 minute · عملي

  • What do you do every day?
  • What is your job?
  • What time do you start and finish?
UsefulEvery day, I …My job is to …I start at … and I finish at …

Tap the card to fold it · اضغط على البطاقة لتطويها

UsefulWelcome to our warehouse.This is my brother, …Nice to meet you.Where are you from?
